name: Falling Debris OLD
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: A net filled with stones and a small anvil crashes down on someone who steps into the room.
disable: DC 17 Thievery to disarm the trap through a cracked-open door, or ◆◆◆ Interact to open the door slowly without triggering the trap

generalAbilities.name: Drop Debris
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door without taking care to avoid triggering the trap;

Effect The net drops a dozen hefty stones and a small but quite hard anvil onto the creature, inflicting 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw). The sound of this trap going off alerts Gurtlekep in area C8.
